issue.title: Profile on property don't work at hot deployment moment
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
When I use a property with profile ("%dev.quarkus.datasource.password") in dev mode and Quarkus applies a hot deployment, the app take an error like this:
    Caused by: java.util.NoSuchElementException: Property quarkus.datasource.password not found

**Expected behavior**
The property should be found.

**Actual behavior**
The property was not found.


**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a app using hibernate
2. Create a datasource using dev profile 
3. Start the app in dev mode
4. Make changes in your code to force the hot deployment

**Configuration**
%dev.quarkus.datasource.url = jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/testDB
%dev.quarkus.datasource.driver = org.postgresql.Driver
%dev.quarkus.datasource.username = admin
%dev.quarkus.datasource.password = admin
```

Fixes #3409.

The old config provider resolver was not being restored
on shutdown, which would cause problems on restarts.

issue.title: Remove dependency management for google-http-client

labels.name: area/dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

issue.body:
The right version is used by JIB without the dependency management part, but this cause an issue for Google Cloud Services that needs a more recent version.

The version was downgraded by #20398 due to issues with JIB and the latest version.

As the Quarkus BOM is included before the Google Cloud Services one, there is no way to override the version on the Google Cloud Services side.

Keep in mind that now, JIB and Google Cloud Services are incompatible extensions.

Another solution would be to revert #20398.
